retro:
# Retrospective

## Worked

Security triage preceded reviewer launch and execution. Team identity and Herdr managed context verified before lifecycle control. Both roles reset into new verified sessions with neutral equivalent scope. Independence preserved until both finals saved. Source-only Sol assessment was proportionate; no artificial extra-test requirement. Opus's narrow extracted-function approach avoided uninspected full-menu writes. No host desktop or service use.

## Friction and corrections

Coordinator initial policy reads exceeded the 60-line correction before it was read; one truncated tail was immediately completed, before lifecycle or runtime work. Corrected to bounded reads thereafter.

Opus fixture guard coverage was overstated: receipt/final writes not individually gated, failure-status target unguarded, substitution producers and cat exit not independently retained, negated grep conflated missing content with errors, and comparator accumulated failures instead of stopping immediately. Original evidence and final preserved. Audit-addendum.md corrects the claims; public evidence narrowed to source and two directly inspected output pairs. No broad totals used. safety_process_compliant=false, with technical publication clearance restricted to these claims.

Assignment correction: future fixtures must treat receipt writers as producers; guard and gate failure paths too; record each read/substitution exit or use checked direct file APIs; explicitly distinguish grep status 1 from >1; fail immediately per comparator case; retain replay child status independently of AWK. This correction was sent to the responsible reviewer, who acknowledged it. No new experiment was warranted for already supported narrow conclusions.

## Tool issues

No confirmed review.py or Herdr defect. No feature request needed. Evidence seals verified. Readiness waits used lifecycle states, not arbitrary sleeps. No resources remain beyond saved artifacts and idle reviewer panes.

## Presentation

Small baseline/PR table retained in Markdown and HTML. Full menu, stock suite, live Hyprland and active-layout limits stated. No generic suggestions. Fresh Astra Medium privacy-inclusive editorial gate passed for the exact draft. Coordinator saved HTML without opening it; only outer assistant may publish.
